Messaging Architecture & Outbox Queue.question: How should queued outbox messages be dispatched and retried?
Messaging Architecture & Outbox Queue.answer: Dual trigger: Immediate async dispatch (sub-second delivery in normal conditions) backed by a scheduled cron endpoint (`/api/cron/dispatch-communications`) to handle retries and outage backlog recovery.
options_presented: Dual trigger: Immediate async dispatch backed by scheduled cron endpoint

Messaging Architecture & Outbox Queue.question: How should platform-level cost controls, message quotas, and channel gating be enforced?
Messaging Architecture & Outbox Queue.answer: Platform Master Config in DB: `tenant_messaging_config` table (or platform admin flags) controlling global switches (`whatsapp_enabled`, `sms_enabled`, monthly message limits, provider routes). Clinic settings UI only lets clinics adjust preferences within what the platform permits, protecting company costs.
